title: Re-review v5t after its NOT READY review's blocking findings (round 2)
description:
Review the epic v5t again, AS INTEGRATED, now that the blocking findings of its NOT READY review are fixed. This is review round 2 of at most 2.

The previous review (54l, decision 7) judged it NOT READY: claude-config workers must actually run on the production hosted (WorkerAgent) door under the subscription interception, and the Go executor must accept the factory's Workers AI step-down, each with a test across the TS/Go seam; its blocking finding(s): "Hosted WorkerAgent door ignores the claude-sub rung; every rung job dies"; "Go executor refuses the factory's Workers AI step-down of a rung dispatch".

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what still blocks it. A NOT READY at this round is not reviewed again by the run unless the tree changes after it: it holds for a person with your reasons.
notes: 2026-10-07 05:30 - ticfac run epic-v5t: DEFERRED FINDING for this review's judgement (key 2b5e40e4ce96ca9a4c1ba001f27009f25738f6fdd87e538b3150554372d28bd4, backlog tick bw7). A worker reported it after the epic's work was done: kind "defect", title "The door's claude-sub step-down is refused by the Go executor's model check", severity high, claiming breaks done item A1 (demonstrated by "cd cloudflare && pnpm vitest run test/sandbox-dispatch.test.ts -t 'steps a rung dispatch down'"). Otherwise it stays backlog and is listed in the epic PR.
